entities.summary: Gwenllian ferch Llywelyn, commonly known as Gwenllian of Wales, was the daughter of Eleanor de Montfort and Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales. Gwenllian is sometimes confused with Gwenllian ferch Gruffudd, who lived two centuries earlier.
